title: Cinna Artifacts — MCP binding
description: The artifact tool a Cinna host registers on the MCP server named `cinna`, beside the task tools of `tasks.schema.json`. Both hosts load this file and assert their registered tools match it. Engine-visible names are derived by the host: Claude Code `mcp__cinna__<tool>`, Codex `mcp.cinna.<tool>`, OpenCode `cinna_<tool>`; Antigravity calls its built-in `call_mcp_tool` with `ServerName: "cinna"` and `ToolName: "<tool>"`. An agent can publish and republish; it cannot share, change visibility or delete. Everything an agent publishes is private to its owner until a person shares it.

artifacts_publish.description: Publish a file or folder from your workspace as an artifact: a page your owner opens in Cinna to read a report, browse files or run a small self-contained dashboard. A folder with `index.html` at its root (or the `entry` you name) becomes a site; a single `.md`, `.csv`, `.pdf`, image or `.html` is fine on its own. Publishing the same `path` again adds a revision to the same artifact instead of creating a new one; pass `artifact_id` to update a specific artifact you published before. The result is private to your owner. Sites run sandboxed: relative paths only, every library bundled into the folder (no CDN), no localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB/cookies, no `new Worker(url)`. Paths the platform never publishes (`.env`, keys, `credentials/`, `.git/`, `node_modules/`) are dropped and listed in `excluded`.

path.description: A file or folder, relative to the workspace root. Build what you publish under `artifacts/<name>/` (`artifacts/q3-dashboard`, `artifacts/summary.md`).

title.description: What a person sees in their artifact list.

description.description: One or two sentences on what this shows and where the data came from.

entry.description: The HTML page to open first, relative to the folder. Defaults to the folder's root `index.html`.

artifact_id.description: Republish into this artifact (an id from an earlier result). Omit to create, or to update the artifact this same `path` was published to.

url.description: The artifact's page in Cinna. Give it to the person; it needs their sign-in.

kind.description: `site` opens a page; `files` shows a file browser or a single-file viewer.

excluded.description: Paths dropped from this revision because they are never published (`.env`, keys, `credentials/`, …).
